name: Sky City Rush
detailed_description:
🏁 About the Game

Get ready to burn rubber and dominate the tracks in a fast-paced, skill-driven arcade racing experience!
This game puts you behind the wheel of high-performance cars as you drift through sharp corners, boost past rivals, and climb the ranks across a variety of exciting race modes and vibrant tracks.

Whether you're a casual player looking for quick action or a seasoned racer chasing perfection, the game offers a finely-tuned balance of challenge, speed, and style. Choose your car, select your track, and master every curve — the road to victory is yours to claim.

🚗 Game Modes

  • Classic Race – Compete for the best finish in high-speed head-to-head races.

  • Elimination Mode – Stay ahead or be knocked out. Survive the countdown and cross the line!

  • Time Trial – Race against the clock to set your personal best lap times.

🌍 Tracks

  • Race across 10 uniquely designed tracks, each with its own layout, environment, and difficulty level.

  • Unlock new tracks by gaining XP and showcase your skills across cityscapes, coastal drives, and futuristic highways.

🛠️ Key Features

  • Responsive Arcade Controls: Tight driving that’s easy to pick up but hard to master.

  • Car Selector: Choose from multiple vehicles, each with distinct stats in speed, acceleration, handling, stability, and pickup.

  • Progression System: Earn XP, unlock tracks, and climb the leaderboard.

  • Performance Metrics Display: Gauge each car's capabilities with detailed stats and metric bars.

  • Stylized Visuals: Clean, colorful UI paired with dynamic race environments.

🎮 Designed for Speed, Built for Replayability

Whether you prefer the thrill of overtaking opponents or shaving milliseconds off your lap time, the game rewards precision and persistence.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2nd gen or newer) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game runs well on entry-level Macs and MacBooks from 2012 onward
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 or Intel Core i5 (8th gen or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU or AMD/NVIDIA GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
